name: Celine G1.0 Intelligence Baseline Cases
purpose: Fixed regression/evaluation catalog. Later brain generations improve against these cases; do not rewrite failures away.

families.memory: Durable recall, correction, relevance and forgetting.
families.reasoning: Multi-step reasoning, uncertainty, contradiction and self-check.
families.tools: Selection, wrong-tool rejection, verification and recovery.
families.restart: Conversation/task continuity across process or device restart.
families.cloud: Cloud dependence, call count, latency observability and offline core.

cases.expected: Treat as continuation of the last unambiguous task, not a new topic.
Continue the last unambiguous action context.
Latest correction overrides the contradicted earlier assumption.
Treat as a correction/redirect, not an unrelated new request.
Do not drag an unrelated older task into a clear new topic.

cases.input: Merk dir, dass mein Testprojekt Orion heißt.
cases.expected: Explicit durable memory is stored and later retrievable.
Correct recall after activity/process restart without fabricating.

cases.input: Nein, das Projekt heißt jetzt Nova.
cases.expected: New explicit correction supersedes the old value rather than coexisting ambiguously.
Retrieve project-name memory without injecting unrelated durable memories.

cases.input: Vergiss nur den Namen des Testprojekts.
cases.expected: Forget the selected memory without clearing unrelated memory.

cases.input: Plane eine dreistufige Aufgabe mit Abhängigkeiten und erkläre nur das Ergebnis.
cases.expected: Decompose internally, preserve dependencies and return a coherent result.

cases.input: Was war der Ausgang eines Ereignisses, zu dem du keine Daten hast?
cases.expected: Distinguish unknown from known and do not invent a result.

cases.input: Eine neue Aussage widerspricht einer gespeicherten älteren Aussage.
cases.expected: Detect conflict and prefer explicit newer evidence or request material clarification.

cases.input: Führe einen wichtigen mehrstufigen Plan aus.
cases.expected: Define success and verify important assumptions/results before claiming completion.
Choose local read-only device status capability without cloud reasoning.

cases.input: Eine Anfrage passt zu keinem registrierten Gerätetool.
cases.expected: Reject wrong/unavailable tool rather than forcing a nearby command.
Execute typed action and verify observed result before reporting success.

cases.input: Tippe auf einen nicht vorhandenen Zieltext und fahre sinnvoll fort.
cases.expected: Observe failure, use bounded recovery/alternative or report precise blocker.

cases.input: Nach Prozessneustart: worüber haben wir gerade gesprochen?
cases.expected: Restore structured working conversation state where policy allows.

cases.input: Nach Neustart: mach bei der offenen Aufgabe weiter.
cases.expected: Resume the durable goal/task at the last confirmed step, not from chat guesswork.
Cloud calls are measured; redundant learning calls are visible and later reducible.
Brain/provider latency is instrumented separately from TTS/UI.
Core conversation/memory/tool routing remains useful with cloud disabled.
